item.title: UK MVNO connections set to surge as fintech brands enter mobile market
item.summary: Connections to UK mobile virtual network operators (MVNOs) will grow 51% between the start of 2026 and the end of 2031, according to new research from FDM CCS Insight, taking their share of the mobile market, excluding machine-to-machine connections, from around 23% today to more than 30%. The post UK MVNO connections set to surge as fintech brands enter mobile market appeared first on Capacity .
